title: Rating Manual — Rental Reimbursement Coverage Premium Proration
content:
**Rule.** Rental Reimbursement Coverage premium is booked only while the coverage is scheduled, active, removed or terminated. The amount is the vehicle's full-term rental premium multiplied by the premium days and divided by the owner term days, rounded to the cent.

## Definitions

- **Full-term rental premium:** the rental premium for the vehicle for the whole owner term.
- **Premium days:** the days the charge or the return covers, the premium being prorated from the effective date.
- **Owner term days:** the days in the owner term.
- **Rounding:** the result of the multiplication and division is rounded once, to the nearest cent, a half cent rounded up.

The coverage premium is the net rental reimbursement premium on the vehicle coverage: premium charged less premium returned.

## When premium is charged or returned

| Occasion | Premium entry |
|---|---|
| Coverage added | Premium charged from the effective date |
| Coverage restored | Premium charged from the restoration date |
| Coverage removed | Unearned premium returned |
| Coverage terminated | Unearned premium returned |

## Status gate

| Status of the rental coverage | Premium may be booked |
|---|---|
| Scheduled | Yes |
| Active | Yes |
| Removed | Yes |
| Terminated | Yes |
| Expired | No |

The status read is the status of the same rental coverage the premium entry belongs to, as the company's records show it when the entry is made.

## Worked figures (hypothetical inputs)

1. Full-term rental premium USD 36.41, owner term of 182 days, premium days 91. USD 36.41 multiplied by 91 is USD 3313.31; divided by 182 it is USD 18.205; rounded to the nearest cent, half up, the amount is USD 18.21.
2. Full-term rental premium USD 52.00, owner term of 182 days, premium days 120. USD 52.00 multiplied by 120 is USD 6240.00; divided by 182 it is USD 34.2857…; rounded to the nearest cent the amount is USD 34.29.
3. A coverage that has expired with its owner term stands as expired, and no premium entry is booked on it.
